title: 1989. Null Reference Checker
description:

Hints & Solutions
Submissions

Null Reference Checker
60
Medium
Problem Statement
Given a list of words where some entries may be missing (represented by the word "null"), safely print the length of each entry using exception handling.
Description
Read an integer n, followed by n words. If a word is exactly "null", store an actual null reference for that position instead of the text. For every position, try to print the length of the string. If the reference is null, catch the exception and print an error message for that position instead.
Input Description
The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100). The next n lines each contain a word, or the literal text "null".
Output Description
For each entry, print its length on its own line. For an entry that is null, print "Error: Null reference encountered" instead.
Sample Input
3
hello
null
java
Sample Output
5
Error: Null reference encountered
4
